description: the change-gate PreToolUse hook exists and is executable
command: [ -x scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: DENY: terraform apply against production is blocked (exit 2) and routed to GitOps
command: printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"terraform apply -auto-approve infra/environments/production"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/tmp/m8g.out 2>/dev/null; [ $? -eq 2 ] && grep -q '"permissionDecision":"deny"' /tmp/m8g.out && echo pass || echo fail

description: DENY: deleting the protected 'production' namespace is blocked (exit 2)
command: printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"kubectl delete namespace production"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: DENY: a mutating kubectl targeting all namespaces (-A) is blocked (exit 2)
command: printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"kubectl delete pods -A"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: DENY: rendering a Secret's decoded value is blocked (exit 2) to keep credentials out of the transcript
command: printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"kubectl get secret db-creds -o yaml"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: DENY: docker push is blocked (exit 2) — images ship through CI, not an agent identity
command: printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"docker push northstar/orders-api:latest"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: ALLOW: terraform plan, dev apply, read-only kubectl -A, and a secret referenced by name all pass the gate (exit 0)
command: for c in 'terraform plan -out=p.tfplan' 'terraform apply infra/environments/dev' 'kubectl get pods -A' 'kubectl get secret db-creds' 'curl -s http://localhost:8080/healthz'; do printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"%s"}}' "$c" | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo fail; exit 0; }; done; echo pass

description: FAIL-CLOSED: the gate blocks (nonzero exit) when it receives no input to evaluate
command: printf '' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: the change-gate hook is wired as a PreToolUse Bash matcher in .claude/settings.json
command: jq -e '.hooks.PreToolUse[] | select(.matcher=="Bash") | .hooks[] | select(.command | test("change-gate"))' .claude/settings.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail

description: the environment contract declares dev/staging/production bundles, each with kubeconfig, allow_apply, allow_delete
command: python3 -c "import yaml;b=(yaml.safe_load(open('contracts/environment-contract.yaml')) or {}).get('bundles',{});import sys;req={'kube_context','kubeconfig','allow_apply','allow_delete'};sys.exit(0 if all(n in b and req<=set(b[n]) for n in ('dev','staging','production')) else 1)" && echo pass || echo fail

description: staging and production bundles are pinned to the read-only identity and forbid apply/delete (agent cannot write them)
command: python3 -c "import yaml;b=yaml.safe_load(open('contracts/environment-contract.yaml'))['bundles'];import sys;sys.exit(0 if all((not b[e]['allow_apply']) and (not b[e]['allow_delete']) and 'readonly' in b[e]['kubeconfig'] for e in ('staging','production')) else 1)" && echo pass || echo fail

description: FAIL-CLOSED: env-check blocks when the declared environment does not match the effective context (declared production, pointed at dev)
command: KUBE_CONTEXT=dev-cluster scripts/env-check.sh production read >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: env-check blocks an apply to staging even when the context matches (allow_apply:false — GitOps only)
command: KUBE_CONTEXT=staging-cluster scripts/env-check.sh staging apply >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: env-check permits a read in dev when the declared environment matches the effective context
command: KUBE_CONTEXT=dev-cluster scripts/env-check.sh dev read >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail

description: THE HOOK IS LIVE: .claude/settings.json registers change-gate.sh as a PreToolUse hook on Bash — the script is a floor under every command, not something you pipe JSON at by hand
command: jq -e '.hooks.PreToolUse[]? | select(.matcher=="Bash") | .hooks[]? | select(.command|test("change-gate"))' .claude/settings.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo wired || echo unwired

description: ENFORCEMENT, NOT INTENT: the gate denies a production apply on its own — the refusal does not depend on a permission prompt being shown, which is why bypass mode cannot get past it
command: echo '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"terraform -chdir=infra/environments/prod apply -auto-approve"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo denied || echo allowed

description: YOUR DEMO: agentops/policy/enforcement-demo.md exists — the prompts-off enforcement result is recorded, not left in a closed terminal
command: [ -f agentops/policy/enforcement-demo.md ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR DEMO: the record names the PreToolUse hook as what stopped the command — enforcement fires before the permission check, which is why skipping prompts did not help
command: F=agentops/policy/enforcement-demo.md; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; grep -qiE 'PreToolUse' "$F" && grep -qiE 'change-gate|exit 2|deny' "$F" && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR RULE: docker compose down -v is blocked (exit 2) — destroying the volume holding persistent data is irreversible
command: printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"docker compose down -v"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR RULE IS NARROW: a bare docker compose down still passes (exit 0) — stopping the stack is routine and reversible
command: printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"docker compose down"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 0 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR TEST: scripts/hooks/gate-cases.sh exists and every deny/allow case passes — the gate is tested, not asserted
command: [ -f scripts/hooks/gate-cases.sh ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; bash scripts/hooks/gate-cases.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail
